test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the triad which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two triads given below. Both triads follow the same pattern.

UN-RK-OQ

SL-PI-MO
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91e09117cbd7fecfce71e947e27303d1a57383c314102085a013827dab04b2d4.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each triad follows the pattern -3, -3 and -3, +6.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/858ba4b537ae6e1aa26885a8413448e8c969b7e069332ca2648e35205d1f2ed0.png] 

SL-PI-MO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c81b86f137c7a9836ed8115692dd6f704d76c9401a710c500c8a266fa3afeff.png] 

Let's check each option:

1. RJ-NG-KL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83cac8f5c745c8f021682452a025a91bf952dd528672c87615f2fbef135908e3.png] 

This triad does not follow the pattern -3, -3 and -3, +6.

2. QJ-NG-KL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0413ca3a8953c35c47397ade9d389bc4e092a4f132d518931a54c421d59db753.png] 

This triad does not follow the pattern -3, -3 and -3, +6.

3. QJ-NG-KM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e44f276ec4f090972c2cc855f67c17b423ad65f56d8dc60911d882a4ec2c95fd.png] 

This triad follows the pattern -3, -3 and -3, +6.

4. RJ-NH-KL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a40b6c1cf2e1fff342862234955a561435233ab62433f8f42f24c6ebca8f3f6.png] 

This triad does not follow the pattern -3, -3 and -3, +6.

Thus, QJ-NG-KM follow the same pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 3**".
